name: Phi Gallery
tagline: A DIY community art space & live music venue on Public Square.
hoursNote: Extended hours for openings, shows & workshops — see the events calendar.

announcement.text: Closed for install this week — back Friday for the opening.

hero.alt: Paintings on display inside Phi Gallery.
hero.heading: Art, music & community on Public Square
hero.subheading: Built by artists, for artists. Exhibits, live shows, workshops, sound healing, and a collective of North Country makers — in the heart of downtown Watertown.

programs.title: Exhibits
programs.text: Rotating visual-art shows from North Country artists — openings, artist talks, and installs on Public Square.

programs.title: Live music
programs.text: An intimate DIY venue for touring and local acts. Loud nights, listening rooms, and everything between.

programs.title: Workshops
programs.text: Literary arts, hands-on making, and skill-shares led by working artists in the community.

programs.title: Sound healing
programs.text: Restorative sound sessions and wellness gatherings with our resident practitioners.

programs.title: Vendor collective
programs.text: A market of local artisans and makers — meet them over on the Partners page.

programs.title: Community
programs.text: A no-gatekeepers space where downtown Watertown's creative community gathers, shows work, and plays shows.

spaceGallery.alt: Wildlife drawings and paintings on display inside Phi Gallery.

homepage.newsletterText: Get the occasional email when new shows and exhibits go up.
